root_idea.summary: The root develops three closely related orientations: placing something first or giving it precedence, transmitting or recounting something received, and a remaining mark, trace, or remnant.
root_idea.development: The lexical branches extend from precedence and preference to reports handed down from earlier people, and to physical or figurative traces that remain after an event or action.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed as the normalized Form I citation form أَثَرَ.
Displayed as the normalized Form IV citation form آثَرَ.
Displayed under the normalized verbal-noun citation form أَثَارَةٌ.
Displayed under the singular noun citation form أَثَرٌ; the Quranic plural and inflected forms are grouped beneath it.

senses.definition: To be transmitted, recited, or repeated as received from another.
senses.usage_conditions: Used here in the passive imperfect for a saying or discourse represented as something handed down or repeated; the contextual rendering “imitated” does not establish a separate imitation sense.

senses.definition: To prefer, favor, choose, or give precedence to one person or thing over another.
senses.usage_conditions: The construction may express preferring someone over oneself or another, choosing something, or favoring one option or value over another.

senses.definition: A surviving remnant or transmitted record of knowledge from earlier generations.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction أَوْ أَثَارَةٍ مِنْ عِلْمٍ, the remnant may be something transmitted orally or preserved in writing.

senses.definition: A remaining trace, remnant, mark, footprint, track, sign, or visible effect of something.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic noun covers physical traces and footprints as well as indications or impressions left by an event or thing. In expressions such as في أثره and على أثره, it denotes following after someone or something, literally as though following the footsteps.

senses.definition: The continuing effects or consequences of a person’s good and evil life, including its resulting reward or punishment.
senses.usage_conditions: This is a Quran-attested interpretive use of آثارهم for what remains consequentially from people’s deeds after their actions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To mark or score the underside of a camel’s foot so that its footprints can be recognized and tracked.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized practice using an iron instrument to make a traceable mark on the foot.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a male camel, to have intercourse with a female camel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized zoological usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To devote one’s undivided attention to an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes applying the mind wholly to the matter at hand.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To determine, resolve, or purpose to do something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of forming a firm intention or decision.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make, leave, or cause an impression, mark, scar, or effect upon someone or something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of physical marks such as those made by a sword or blow, and figuratively of influence or impact.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause one thing to be followed by another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional causative construction describing ordered succession.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To honor or show particular respect to someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Classical usage distinct from preferring one option or person over another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To receive an impression or mark, or to become affected, impressed, or influenced.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The form expresses undergoing the effect rather than causing it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To follow someone’s footsteps, especially diligently or perseveringly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of persistent tracking or close pursuit.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To appropriate something exclusively for oneself or choose the best portion for oneself over others.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction may be استأثر بالشيء or استأثر على أصحابه; it describes exclusive possession or self-preference.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take someone exclusively to oneself, used euphemistically of death.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Especially used in the expression استأثر الله بفلان, implying that God took the person to Himself and that good is hoped for him.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The variegated grain, streaks, lustre, or glitter of a sword.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical description of the patterned or shining surface of a blade.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A scar remaining after a wound has healed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A lasting mark on the body.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mark made on the underside of a camel’s foot to make its footprints traceable.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Refers either to the mark itself or to the marked foot in this specialized practice.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Lustre or brightness of the face.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A bodily appearance characterized by visible radiance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The clarified residue of butter, or, according to another usage, the milk left when the butter has separated.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A culinary and dairy term with variant explanations in the lexical tradition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A transmitted tradition, report, narrative, or account handed down from earlier authorities.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In technical usage it may refer especially to reports from the Companions or to inherited religious practice, though it can also denote a report more generally.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person’s origin or known lineage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in expressions asking where someone’s origin is known to be.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The term or period of a person’s life.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Explained as what follows life, or as a metaphor from footprints ceasing after death.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who chooses the good portions or good qualities for himself in preference to his companions.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A personal وصف describing self-preference in division or allocation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mark or abrasion made on the underside of a camel’s foot so that its footprints can be recognized.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The mark may be made with the instrument called مِئْثَرَة or تُؤْثُور.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A preference, special favor, or favored status.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of having precedence in someone’s estimation or being a favorite with a person of authority.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Dearth, scarcity, drought, sterility, or an unpleasant condition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate nominal usage describing an adverse state or lack of productivity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Appropriating something exclusively for oneself, or choosing and taking the best portion for oneself.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes self-preference in distribution, especially taking the best share instead of sharing it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A residue or remnant, such as old fat remaining on which animals have become fat, or anger that still remains.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Classical uses extend the idea of a remaining portion to physical residue and a lingering emotional state.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Describing a beast that makes a large footprint.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used particularly of an animal’s hoof or soft foot.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person possessing power or authority, or one who is honored.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A personal adjective with a plural أُثَرَاءُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A particular friend, favorite, or person specially preferred by another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in constructions expressing favored status or personal preference.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Abundant, copious, or numerous.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An imitative or echoic intensifying usage in the expression شيء كثير أثِير.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The ether, conceived in cosmology as the highest sphere governing the other spheres.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical cosmological term, explained through its supposed influence on other spheres.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who relates or recites a tradition, narrative, or story as received from another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes a transmitter or narrator of inherited reports.

other_classical_meanings.definition: First, foremost, or preferentially; with care and precedence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Appears in idioms meaning to do something first of all, at least, or in preference to another thing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A generous quality or action inherited or transmitted from one’s ancestors; a deed bringing glory.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May denote an inherited virtue, a traditionally recounted noble deed, or a ground for pride and precedence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An iron instrument used to mark or scrape the underside of a camel’s foot so that its footprints can be traced.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized tracking implement; the saddle term مِيثَرَة is distinguished in pronunciation and meaning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A camel whose foot has been marked or scraped so that its footprints can be recognized.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive descriptive adjective referring to the result of the camel-marking practice.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sword with distinctive wavy grain or lustre, or an ancient sword handed down through eminent owners.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word can describe the blade’s patterned surface or its inherited antiquity and prestige.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Handed-down as a tradition, narrative, or report.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of material transmitted from one generation or person to another.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Influence and produced effect are covered by the broader impression/effect meaning.
Choosing or electing is covered by preference and precedence.
Becoming affected is covered by undergoing an impression or influence.
Figurative effects and impressions are covered by the trace, mark, and visible-effect sense.
Way-marking signs are covered by the sign and track sense.

cautions: The printed Lane Quran citation for آثارهم uses historical notation (“Kur. xxxvi. 11”); it has not been converted directly into a modern verse location. Modern Quran examples here use only locations independently supplied by QAC.

The contextual rendering “imitated” for يُؤْثَرُ is presented under the independently supported transmission/recitation branch; the packet does not establish a separate Quranic lexical sense meaning imitation.
